title: Bachelor Golf Round
dress_code: Golf Attire: Collared shirts, golf shorts/slacks, soft spikes.

title: Welcome Pool Party
description: Kick off the weekend with drinks and casual bites by the pool.
dress_code: Desert Casual: Relaxed, elevated poolside attire. Light, breathable fabrics, resort wear, sundresses, linen sets, and stylish cover-ups are all welcome. Swimsuits are encouraged for those who want to swim.

title: Bridal Party Champagne Toast
dress_code: Cute & Comfy: Think robes, pajamas, or getting-ready glam we toast with champagne and get the day started.

title: Yoga Session
description: A relaxing morning yoga flow to stretch and reset.
dress_code: Activewear: Comfortable athletic clothing, mats will be provided.

title: The Ceremony
description: Our vows under the desert palms, and a special moment to cherish for a lifetime.
dress_code: Desert Formal: Suits in any color or tone are welcome, and lightweight fabrics are encouraged for comfort. Ladies may wear elegant cocktail, midi, or floor-length dresses. Block heels, wedges, or other outdoor-friendly footwear are recommended.

title: Cocktail Hour
description: Custom cocktails from Kelsey & Alexis's shared experiences.

title: The Reception
description: A dinner by the incredible Chef Joann, followed by music and dancing on the lawn.

title: The Afters
description: The party continues with full drink service and casual bar fare.
dress_code: Late-Night Casual: Keep the celebration going in whatever feels comfortable. Guests are welcome to change into something more relaxed after the wedding. Most importantly, wear what lets you dance and enjoy the night.
